digest.component_or_area: LLM plan-review/code-review gate signed verdict provenance
propositions: Signed gate verdicts record only a resolved provider:model string, so a consumer cannot distinguish a Bedrock-backed verdict from an Ollama-backed one.
Add a sibling provider_provenance object (provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, capabilities) as a backward-compatible additive field that legacy readers ignore.
The provenance record must be assembled in leaf module capabilities.py from primitives, reusing the caps record already resolved once per run rather than recomputing it.
endpoint_host must use urlparse(base_url).hostname to strip credentials; no username, password, or api_key may appear anywhere in the persisted payload.
providers.py sits at 299/300 LOC against an attested cap, so provenance assembly must not be added there.
Production wiring is incomplete: plan-review gate verdicts assembled by finalize_verdict never carry provider_provenance, so the field is absent from real sidecars despite passing unit tests.
